Plan-time grep found a SECOND-ORDER defect the research report did not cover: all three next_artifact_number advance sites (orchestrator-postflight.sh:365, orchestrate-stage5-postflight.sh:276, orchestrate-cycle-postflight.sh:1610) advance via (.next_artifact_number // 1) + 1, so after the read-side fix mints round 2 for a pre-supplied-01 task, postflight would still store 2 (not 3) and the next plan dispatch would resolve round 1 again. class: deviation from plan literal text, caught at Phase 5 verification
what_happened: Phase 1's implementation of the stored= read kept the jq expression '.next_artifact_number // 1' (with the // 1 default) rather than the plan's exact '.next_artifact_number' (no default). Behaviorally inert in every tested case: derived (max_on_disk+1) is always >= 1, so max(stored, derived) is identical whether the absent-field floor is 0 (plan's text, via the case-statement null-catch) or 1 (// 1's default, which the case-statement's digit-only pattern does not catch). Caught at Phase 5's own verification bullet ('the deployed skill-base.sh contains no .next_artifact_number // 1 read'), which the task was explicitly created to eliminate this exact substring for.
